annotations.title: JSON to typed models (TypeScript, Zod, Go, Pydantic, Rust)

description: JSON to typed models (TypeScript, Zod, Go, Pydantic, Rust) — Paste a sample JSON document (json=, URL-encoded) or point at a JSON URL (url=) and get ready-to-use type definitions: TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas, Go structs with json tags, Pydantic v2 models with aliases, or Rust serde structs. Nested objects become named types, arrays of objects are merged (fields missing from some items become optional, nulls become nullable, int+float become float), ISO timestamps become datetime in Pydantic/Zod. Params: json= or url=; lang= ts|zod|go|pydantic|rust|all (default ts); name= root type name (default Root). Offline, no AI. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dev_json_types
